testimonialsSection.sectionSubtitle: Real experiences from people who rely on our accessible taxi service throughout Israel.

items.name: David Cohen
items.content: The accessible taxi service has been a lifesaver for my mother. The driver is always punctual and extremely helpful with her wheelchair.

items.name: Sarah Levy
items.content: I rely on this service for all my medical appointments. The vehicle is clean, comfortable, and the ramp makes boarding so much easier.

items.name: Mohammed Amir
items.content: Excellent service that has made traveling much more accessible for my family. Highly recommended for anyone with mobility needs.

items.name: Rachel Goldstein
items.content: The emergency service is remarkable. When I needed urgent transport for my grandfather, they arrived within 15 minutes.
